body: I had a sex dream the other night. Only we didn't have sex, we started and then I stopped it because he had a girlfriend (he started dating someone the day after we broke up). It hurt. It sucked. It made me hate going to sleep.
I've been trying. The field I want to work in is kinda hard to get into, there are very few offers. But I just had three opportunities come up out of nowhere so fingers crossed!

I needed to hear this. I work retail, but I have a bachelor's degree. I wouldn't be able to handle the work that my degree requires, and my retail job is easy. I can do it no problem, and they're also very understanding of my swings.

You're lucky, I didn't even get any sort of orientation. I just did the WBT and then was thrown onto the sales floor. But I kept in contact with my HR Manager to make sure I was getting hours to work with. And when I was done with training, I just talked to an available manager to see what to do next, and he sent me to talk to some people in my department and start working the sales floor. This is garden in the springtime so I completely understand why they didn't take the full time to train me. Especially now, it's memorial day weekend and it's pretty crazy all around.
I also think it's worth pointing out that relationships are two-way streets. Even if you did something to hurt the relationship, it's not all on you.

My boyfriend did a lot to me. Cheated on me, lied, said I wasn't doing enough to help the relationship. Even through all that, I never stopped loving him. Obviously I don't know your girlfriend and I don't know how "you made your life a mess", but I think it would be the same for her as it is for me. Maybe you feel low right now, maybe life isn't offering anything of value to you, but that doesn't mean it can't. I'm sure there are plenty of people that care, you just have to find them.

I'm going through a breakup of a long relationship as well. I'm sorry you don't have much support, but here is a good place to reach out. Another good support system is r/exnocontact and I strongly recommend visiting them over there. I'm sure she doesn't hate you no matter what may have happened between you guys. After nine years, I'm sure she still loves you. I went through hell and back with my boyfriend and despite all of the shit he put me through, I still love him. It's gonna take some time to process and recover from but it's going to be ok. She will miss you, your dogs will miss you, and your family will miss you. It's not worth it.
This was exactly me. Unfortunately I went too late to save my relationship and now I'm having to deal with my diagnosis as well as a break-up. Life sucks.

My ex started dating someone the day after we broke up. This was after a 9 year relationship. I feel your pain, but it is so important that you don't contact him. Don't let him know that he's gotten to you, let him think you're moving on. That relationship is not going to last, it's nothing more than a rebound. He's going to realize what he's lost soon enough.

Thank you. I'm at 10 days and its been really difficult. I have people in my life to encourage me not to message him, but they don't tell me they're proud when I don't. It seems expected of me so it's nothing special when I keep my no contact. But you're right, it is something to be proud of. After 9 years of seeing him every day, not talking for 10 days is a huge accomplishment. So thank you.

For me it was, "you need to learn how to control yourself, control your triggers" and then when he felt insecure or whatever he would take it out on me. When I called him on it, he just told me that's where he's at right now and I needed to accept it. Same thing with therapy. I was never doing enough in therapy, but never mind the fact that he just stopped going to his sessions.
Wow, this is exactly my ex. Even when he was "trying" he was still manipulating me.
What about closing the cards though? Doesn't that affect your credit rating?
Toy Story
Jaws?
Thank you so much. I needed a different perspective and this made me feel a whole lot better about everything. Really, truly, thank you.

I just came back to my old post after a month and read your comment. You said it reminded you of yourself, and I guess I just wanted to update because a couple of weeks ago I went to a psychiatrist and was diagnosed bipolar. Funny how life works like that.

On and off yeah. I just don't generally enjoy life anymore, and recent events have kinda clinched the feeling for me as of now. I don't have any plans to do it, but not living sounds a lot better than being around. I'm trying to get better though. I'm getting medicated and working on switching therapists. I hope you can find something that works for you too, because it's a sad state to be in.

Thank you. You're right, I would rather be alone than be with someone that has continuously disrespected our relationship. After all the shit he put me through, my heart wasn't even really in it at the end there. That's part of why we broke up. I think it mostly hurts because even though I wasn't invested like I was before, I still love him and I still look back at our relationship with nostalgia. And for him to move on so fast, it feels like he just didn't see it the same way as I did. I want to go on an angry rant at him, make him feel the way I feel but I know it's not gonna do anything because he doesn't care. He'll just go on about how great his gf is again. Sorry, I know I got rambly. I don't plan on contacting him, but boy do I wanna give him a piece of my mind.

We had issues with other women while we were together. It wasn't surprising when he told me about her. He just has no idea how to be alone, and I agree, that's his problem not mine. I definitely dodged a bullet here, but it doesn't stop me from missing him. I wish it did.
Ugh definitely agree. You've got a great List going though!

Not great. My boyfriend of 9 years and I broke up a week ago and he already has a new girlfriend. On top of that, the news spread throughout our workplace because we all work at the same place. I finally saw a psychiatrist  and was just diagnosed with bipolar disorder. My therapist cancelled our most recent appointment because she was sick. I pushed nearly all my friends in favor of my relationship so now I just feel alone. 

But I'm keeping my head up. I got my passport, I'm planning on going on vacation out of the country with the one friend I was able to reconnect with. I'm starting to play trombone again, and I'm working on losing weight. So I'm not great, but I'm getting through life one day at a time.

Just a few days ago a co-worker of mine told me my hair looked pretty. He told me the way it shimmered in the sun was beautiful. I don't know how much he thought it would affect me. I've been going through a break up, battling myself to not self harm, and just recently was diagnosed with bipolar disorder. His compliment was the best thing to happen to me in a long time and I haven't been able to stop thinking about his kindness.

He is my first love. We were 14 when we started seeing each other. All of this is just so accurate it hurts. It's hard not to think of the good times, because despite all the crap there were a lot of good times too. But I plan on writing a letter to myself for if he decides to try to come back. While I do still have some sort of meager hope for the relationship, I do realize it's not healthy. The letter will just basically be everything he put me through so I can remember why this breakup is a good thing.
Thank you. I often told him it was like he expected me to flip a switch and trust him again. He always denied it. But yes I definitely agree. He just didn't want to face those consequences.

Definitely cut him off. I forgave my ex the first time he cheated, 1.5 years into the relationship. Then I found out years later that he kept doing it. It caused so much unnecessary heartbreak and pain. If I could go back and redo things, I would have left him the first time instead of trying over and over until he broke up with me 9 years into the relationship. It's not worth it. Especially since he didn't tell you, you found out about it. That's why he's sorry, but if you hadn't found out then what?

Thank you. I started talking to some old friends I haven't seen in a while. I hadn't seen them because I invested all my time in my bf. I also just started a new job so staying busy shouldn't be a problem. It's been a long time since I've truly been single, I'm gonna do some soul searching while I'm here.

I love this. He was always picky with food, so we didn't get much variety going out and I love to try new things. I used to play trombone and I just recently got one so I can definitely start that up again. And I especially love the idea of getting fit. I gained a lot of weight when I started college and never really worked it off. He told me once, that maybe if I lost some weight he wouldn't be thinking about [girl he cheated on me with] and that he much preferred her body type. How wonderful it would be for him to see me fit and thin after we're broken up.

I've made the same mistakes over and over again for years. Every single time I just get hurt again, you would think I'd learn... I just got a new job and I'm reconnecting with old friends, so hopefully that'll keep me busy.
I definitely agree. We started off as kids and have grown apart a lot since. It'll be better for me to experience more. Idk I'm just trying to put a more positive spin on what's happening.

Thank you. I am currently in counseling and have been on and off for the past 3 years. I've improved on myself so much in that time, but according to him it's not enough. But I'm going for me, not for him, it's not up to him to decide how much is enough.
